dsr_pbo_informational.pbo_full_grid_note: NOT reconstructable: Stage A's results_ctaA_full_grid.csv.gz persists only per-cell SUMMARY METRICS, not each of the 29,760/9,920 cells' full daily net-return path, so a literal CSCV-PBO over the complete grid cannot be computed post-hoc without re-running the entire Stage-A grid with full return-path retention (out of Stage B's scope). Reported as None rather than fabricated.
dsr_pbo_informational.pbo_proxy_note: Genuine CSCV-PBO (Bailey et al. 2015, n_splits=8) computed over a REAL, cheaply-reconstructable 12-member family (the winner's and runner-up's own already-computed 13bp cost-applied book returns, x all 6 frozen Axis-E leverage policies) -- an honest, clearly-scoped supplementary number, NOT a substitute for the full-grid PBO above.
